title: Rabbi Abba son of Rav Yosef bar Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 141a, where he spoke to Rav Kahana (Rav Ashi’s teacher). Hyman identifies this Rabbi Abba as the grandson of “Rava.” See the entry Rava son of Rav Yosef.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Chullin 141a paragraph fully names Rabbi Abba son of Rav Yosef bar Rava addressing Rav Kahana, supporting the daf reference rather than “first chapter.” The identification of Rav Kahana as Rav Ashi’s teacher and the genealogical interpretation remain Hyman’s.
